name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
beneficiaries: Families Living in Kutcha / Dilapidated Houses
description: Flagship rural housing scheme providing financial assistance to eligible rural households for construction of a permanent pucca house with basic amenities.

benefit.description: ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/IAP districts directly transferred via DBT. Additional ₹12,000 for toilet construction under SBM-G + 90-95 days unskilled wage support under MGNREGS (approx ₹25,000).

general: Rural households with no pucca house or living in zero/one/two room kutcha houses
Identified through Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) / Awaas+ list
otherConditions: Family must not own a motorised two/three/four-wheeler or mechanised agricultural equipment
No family member should be a government employee

eligibilityChecks.question: Do you live in a rural area and currently lack a permanent pucca concrete house?
Is your family registered in the Gram Panchayat Awaas+ or SECC housing deprivation list?
Are you confirmed to have no government employees or motorized 4-wheelers in your family?

requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card of all adult family members
Land / House site ownership document or consent letter
Photographs of current kutcha house site
applicationProcess: Registration done through Gram Panchayat / Village Secretariat using Awaas+ mobile app by Panchayat Secretary
Gram Sabha verifies beneficiary eligibility list through social audit
Block Development Officer (BDO) issues Geo-tagged sanction order
Direct Benefit Transfer released in 3-4 installments upon geo-tagged photo verification at plinth, lintel, and completion stages

applicationWindow.details: Continuous verification and target allocation as per state targets

aiContext: Provides ₹1.20 Lakh (plain) / ₹1.30 Lakh (hilly) + ₹12,000 toilet grant + 90 days MGNREGA wages to build a pucca rural house. Geo-tagged DBT verification.

faqs.question: Who verifies the construction progress for installment release?
faqs.answer: The Gram Rozgar Sahayak / Panchayat Secretary uploads geo-tagged photographs of the house at each stage via the AwaasApp.

faqs.question: Is toilet assistance included?
faqs.answer: Yes, an additional ₹12,000 is provided through Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin) for building a dedicated attached toilet.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0
description: Urban housing scheme aimed at providing all-weather pucca houses to eligible urban families through Beneficiary-Led Construction, Affordable Housing in Partnership, and Interest Subsidy Schemes.

benefit.description: Central assistance of ₹1.50 Lakh to ₹2.50 Lakh under Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC), or Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS) of up to ₹1.80 Lakh on home loans for EWS/LIG/MIG segments.

general: Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house in their name anywhere in India
EWS household annual income up to ₹3,00,000
LIG household annual income ₹3,00,001 to ₹6,00,000; MIG up to ₹9,00,000
Female head of household must be co-owner/owner in property registration
otherConditions: Must reside in statutory towns as per Census 2011 or notified planning areas

eligibilityChecks.question: Do you live in an urban municipal area and have no pucca house anywhere in India?
Is your annual family income within ₹9 Lakh (EWS/LIG/MIG limits)?
Is a female family member listed as sole owner or co-owner of the property?

requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Income Certificate / Salary Slips / Form 16 / ITR
Land Title / Patta / Approved House Building Plan (for BLC component)
Bank Account Statement & Loan Sanction Letter (for Interest Subsidy component)
Affidavit affirming no other pucca property owned in India
applicationProcess: Visit the PMAY-Urban portal (pmaymis.gov.in) or visit nearest Citizen Service Centre (CSC) / Municipal Corporation office
Select 'Citizen Assessment' and choose appropriate vertical (BLC, ISS, or AHP)
Enter Aadhaar number and fill demographic, income, and existing shelter details
Upload land and income documents; Municipality conducts site verification
Direct Benefit Transfer / Interest subsidy credited directly into loan account

applicationWindow.details: Online applications open under PMAY-U 2.0 mission guidelines

dependsOn: Urban Local Body town planning approval

verification: Municipal Corporation / ULB Town Planning Cell
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
aiContext: Central urban housing grant up to ₹2.50 Lakh for self-construction or interest subsidy on home loans for urban families earning up to ₹9 Lakh without a pucca house.

faqs.question: Is female ownership mandatory in PMAY-U?
faqs.answer: Yes, for EWS and LIG categories, the house must be registered in the name of the female head or in joint ownership with husband.

faqs.question: Can I get subsidy if I already bought a flat via home loan?
faqs.answer: Under the Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS), the upfront subsidy is credited directly to your loan account reducing EMIs.
